stories.title: Police continue search for missing 16-year-old last seen at Talacre Beach Resort
stories.summary: Police have issued a fresh appeal for help to find a 16-year-old boy missing from Talacre since Sunday evening. stories.title: Parents’ lawyers give Flintshire Council 24 hours to reveal true cost of £55m Catholic super-school plan
stories.summary: An eight-page legal letter by parents is demanding Flintshire Council answers key questions and provides a full updated cost for its Catholic super-school plan by tomorrow. stories.title: Dog exercise paddock owner to appeal after Flintshire planning committee refuses Penymynydd scheme

stories.title: Airbus launches three-year flight test campaign for Wing of Tomorrow programme

stories.title: Electricity bill tax cut expected to take around £45 a year off household bills
stories.summary: VAT on household electricity bills will be scrapped from 1 October, a change the UK government estimates will take around £45 a year off a typical bill for homes across Flintshire.
